description: Atomically increments the value of an attribute and return its new value.

parameters.name: bind_dn
parameters.description: A DN to bind with. Try to use a SASL bind with the EXTERNAL mechanism as default when this parameter is omitted. Use an anonymous bind if the parameter is blank.

parameters.name: bind_pw
parameters.description: The password to use with bind_dn. Default: ""

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: Set the path to PEM file with CA certs.

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. Required if client_key is defined.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. Required if client_cert is defined.

parameters.name: dn
parameters.description: The DN entry containing the attribute to increment.

parameters.name: increment
parameters.description: The value of the increment to apply. Default: 1

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: If auto, the module determines automatically the method to use. If rfc4525 or legacy force to use the corresponding method. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "rfc4525" "legacy"

parameters.name: referrals_chasing
parameters.description: Set the referrals chasing behavior. anonymous follow referrals anonymously. This is the default behavior. disabled disable referrals chasing. This sets OPT_REFERRALS to off. Choices: "disabled" "anonymous" ← (default)

parameters.name: sasl_class
parameters.description: The class to use for SASL authentication. Choices: "external" ← (default) "gssapi"

parameters.name: server_uri
parameters.description: The server_uri parameter may be a comma- or whitespace-separated list of URIs containing only the schema, the host, and the port fields. The default value lets the underlying LDAP client library look for a UNIX domain socket in its default location. Note that when using multiple URIs you cannot determine to which URI your client gets connected. For URIs containing additional fields, particularly when using commas, behavior is undefined. Default: "ldapi:///"

parameters.name: start_tls
parameters.description: Use the START_TLS LDAP extension if set to true. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If set to false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: xorder_discovery
parameters.description: Set the behavior on how to process Xordered DNs. enable performs a ONELEVEL search below the superior RDN to find the matching DN. disable always uses the DN unmodified (as passed by the dn parameter). auto only performs a search if the first RDN does not contain an index number ({x}). Choices: "enable" "auto" ← (default) "disable"

examples:
- name: Increments uidNumber 1 Number for example.com
  community.general.ldap_inc:
    dn: "cn=uidNext,ou=unix-management,dc=example,dc=com"
    attribute: "uidNumber"
    increment: "1"
  register: ldap_uidNumber_sequence

- name: Modifies the user to define its identification number (uidNumber) when incrementation is successful
  community.general.ldap_attrs:
    dn: "cn=john,ou=posix-users,dc=example,dc=com"
    state: present
    attributes:
      - uidNumber: "{{ ldap_uidNumber_sequence.value }}"
  when: ldap_uidNumber_sequence.incremented

return_values.name: attribute
return_values.description: The name of the attribute that was incremented. Returned: success Sample: "uidNumber"

return_values.name: incremented
return_values.description: It is set to true if the attribute value has changed. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: rfc4525
return_values.description: Is true if the method used to increment is based on RFC4525, false if legacy. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The new value after incrementing. Returned: success Sample: "2"
